# UC-LEARN19 — Intent Inspector — PAR/RAR payloads

**Track:** learn  
**Maturity:** ✅ `works`  


## Buyer Story

The intent-binding story raises "what exactly got pushed?" — the inspector shows the pushed authorization request and its authorization_details.

## PingOne Solution

The Intent Inspector renders the PAR request objects and RFC 9396 authorization_details that UC14/UC14b push, so the audience can read the intent contract.

## How to Run

**Trigger:** Trigger (link): `{"type":"link","path":"/intent-inspector","label":"Open Intent Inspector"}`  
**Expected outcome:** `GUIDED_LEARNING`

## What to Say

> This is the contract UC14 and UC14b are judged against — the pushed intent, amount cap and payee, in the raw JSON Authorize evaluates.
